evaluations.evidence: As a anonymoususer, I want to receive a notification when I submit a session
evaluations.rationale: This implies anonymous users can submit sessions, which conflicts with BC-063 that requires authenticated users to submit sessions. Anonymous submission vs authenticated-only submission are incompatible permissions.
Authenticated users editing their session does not itself conflict with other stories (no story forbids editing by authenticated users).

evaluations.evidence: As a anonymoususer, I want to register to speak at BADCamp, so that I submit a session.
evaluations.rationale: Allows anonymous users to submit sessions, which directly conflicts with BC-063 that requires submission by authenticated users only (incompatible permissions).

Requiring authenticated users to submit sessions is not itself contradicted by other stories unless anonymous submission stories are considered; conflicts are detected on those anonymous stories (BC-060, BC-062).
